title: Careers
seoDescription: Careers and opportunities at Schnurr Painting.

hero.intro: Commercial painting careers with teams focused on quality, safety, and professionalism.
hero.title: Build good work with good people.

sections.title: Work on commercial projects that matter.
sections.copy: Schnurr Painting crews work across a range of commercial environments—auditoriums, healthcare facilities, high-rises, and more—with an emphasis on quality, safety, and professionalism.

sections.title: A safety record that protects you, not just the schedule.
sections.copy: 0.68 EMR safety rating, OSHA-certified crews, and weekly toolbox talks before work begins. Safety here isn't a poster in the breakroom—it's how jobs actually get planned.

sections.title: Grow with experienced teams.
sections.copy: 20+ years in business means steady commercial work, not gig-to-gig uncertainty. The company values people who communicate well, take ownership of the work, and want to build lasting trade skills.
